environment.honestyNote: Headless sandbox browser using SwiftShader SOFTWARE rasterization. Absolute FPS values are NOT representative of real hardware. All three lanes measured under the IDENTICAL rasterizer, so relative pipeline cost is the meaningful signal.
environment.method: requestAnimationFrame frame counting over a 3000 ms window, per lane

lanes.lane: mk1-gameplay-render-demo (game pipeline + MK-I, 6 draw calls, 728 tris + glow pass)
lanes.note: Frame-capped. Cost profile comparable to the game's own pipeline — confirms the MK-I data fits the game's render budget.

lanes.lane: playable-game (in-flight, briefing dismissed, score 20 on screen)
lanes.note: The shipped game scene (tunnel, objects, stars, player, glow pass) under software rendering.

lanes.lane: sovereign-hangar (Three.js PBR, PMREM env, real-time planar reflector, auto orbit)
lanes.note: Heaviest pipeline by ~12x vs the game lane under identical rasterization. Risk input for any gameplay-quality upgrade: hangar-grade visuals in the live game require a hardware budget check and/or a quality tier.

measurementIntegrity.gameSessionStart: Flight started via DOM activation of the 'Tap to fly' button because the invisible discovery-survey overlay (pre-existing game defect, see FINDINGS.md F-1) intercepts hit-tested clicks. The activation itself is the button's own click handler — no game code modified.
measurementIntegrity.hangarAndDemo: Direct page load, no workarounds needed.
